findings: `checkExpiredSubscriptions` never fires — no @Cron decorator, no ScheduleModule, no HTTP endpoint. Add @nestjs/schedule + @Cron(CronExpression.EVERY_DAY_AT_MIDNIGHT) or expose a protected admin endpoint.

`respondToReview` has no role guard — controller applies JwtAuthGuard only; any authenticated user reaches the service before being rejected. Add @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, RolesGuard) and @Roles(UserRole.HOTEL_OWNER).

`suspendSubscription` and `reactivateSubscription` fetch with no status filter — can act on ARCHIVED or already-SUSPENDED subscriptions silently. Add a status precondition check and throw BadRequestException for invalid transitions.
